web_desc: Apple Health and Health Connect work in the iOS and Android apps.
intro: A two-way link between your phone's health app and Anacan.
dir_in_ios: Your steps, workouts and mindful minutes appear here
dir_in_android: Your steps and workouts appear here
dir_out_desc: Your weight, blood pressure, blood sugar and period records are copied
install_desc: Health Connect is missing on this phone or needs an update.
empty_ios: Open the Health app on your iPhone → your profile picture → Apps → Anacan → “Turn On All”. Steps are recorded by your iPhone or Apple Watch.
empty_android: In Health Connect: App permissions → Anacan → Steps and Exercise. Steps must be written to Health Connect by Google Fit, Samsung Health or another app.
no_access_desc: Anacan isn't allowed to read your steps and workouts.
load_error: Couldn't read your data. Please try again.
vitals_desc: Weight, blood pressure and blood sugar — copied as soon as you save them
cycle_desc: Period days you log in Flow mode
sync_failed: Some records weren't copied. We'll try again next time.
vitals_on: Measurements from the last 30 days and all new records will be copied.
cycle_on: Period days you log from now on will be copied.
denied_desc: You can allow it in {platform} settings.
unavailable_update: This needs a newer version of the app.
disconnected_toast: Reading stopped. You can also remove permissions in system settings.
privacy: Data read from your health app is shown only on your phone and never sent to our servers. Copying works only when you turn it on.
